modern: The healthy eye ought to see all visible things and not to say, I want green things; for this is the condition of a diseased eye. And healthy hearing and smell ought to be ready to perceive all that can be heard and smelled. And the healthy stomach ought to be, with respect to all food, just as the mill is with respect to all the things which it is made to grind. And so the healthy understanding ought to be prepared for everything which happens; but that which says, Let my dear children live, and let all men praise whatever I may do, is an eye which looks for green things, or teeth which look for soft things.
original: The healthy eye ought to see all visible things and not to say, I wish for green things; for this is the condition of a diseased eye. explained.summary:
A healthy eye sees whatever is there instead of demanding only green things. Healthy hearing and smell take in everything, and a healthy stomach deals with all food, like a mill grinding whatever it’s given.

A healthy mind should likewise be ready for whatever happens. Insisting ’let my children live’ or ’let everyone praise what I do’ is like an eye that wants only green, or teeth that will only chew soft food. Even the dearest wishes become a weakness when your peace depends on them.
explained.today: Demanding that everything goes smoothly, that the review is glowing, the holiday sunny and the children always well, is like living on mashed potato. A sturdy mind can digest bad news along with the good.
